scope: PC contracts; never physical-device or driving approval

identity_and_delivery.preserve: Keep all model choices, N16 default, boot-frozen selection, exact per-model package/hash/size and rollback checks.

fov_center_hud_integration.preserve: Stock/65/70/75/80 live wide-only FOV; unchanged narrow input; PV5-only independent default-OFF road/wide exposure assist with bounded bias, stock fallback, lens isolation and no extra inference; PV5-only default-OFF lane-edge assist on the selected control path, not continuous Blendful/modeld injection. New Pv5LaneBoundaryAssist does not inherit old ON. Keep zero extra correction inside the body-clearance corridor, bounded inward-only correction, original lateral admission/driver and signal yielding, cached20Hz geometry and all downstream limits; HUD message freshness on every model; Common Carrot coherent vision transition for every vehicle using the existing DPath path, identical live/replay policy, original radar-mode boundaries and upstream-equivalent outputs; no PV5 gate for this explicitly authorized exception. Preserve PV5-only independent default-OFF whole-box metering options, saved base precedence, constant box size, geometry-only positioning, smooth return, original EOF freshness, no lane-pixel weights, extra inference or model-FOV movement. Preserve PV5-only synthetic signal-stop request/publish/final-SCC/feedback wire tags, 0.2s input freshness, finite <=0.7m/s wheel/raw speeds, existing stop interlocks, actual-lead priority, TX-only data and non-PV5/no-request CAN parity. New development-branch SCC identity continuity and fresh-stationary shielding are PV5-only opt-ins at live and complete-metadata replay constructors; common 0.20s vision handover stays enabled for all existing DPath cars. Reset refinement history on stream resets/clock discontinuity. Verify immediate braking-lead/re-ID/cut-out/new-queue/moving-cut-in selection and disclose the three-frame stopped-side-entry confirmation cost. Original Blendful remains an offline reference only; do not restore runtime modeld injection. Lane-edge assist has no separate18km/h gate: preserve existing vehicle admission, standstill and driver/signal yielding. max(v,1)^2 is numeric normalization only; verify tiny speeds and transitions, exact zero protection and >=1m/s command parity. Preserve all five models and native HUD lane-edge wording.

hud_and_alerts.preserve: Lane probabilities, steering, correction/wait reason, camera target/distance and curve speeds, C3X/Jetson notices throughout each fresh active condition with no timed expiry, a one-second minimum settled hold and upward exit after the condition clears, immediate driver-attention glyph and alert priority, BSD pulse and existing Q92/FPS choices. PV5 native CCNC same-side BSD plus turn request: steady red background5 and 200ms-on/200ms-off red lane-highlight5 with side BCA indication, independent of model lane visibility. Preserve native higher-priority alerts and stock warning fields, existing cadence/counters/checksum; Jetson gradient/bracket behavior unchanged. Physical PV5 palette acceptance is not proven by packet tests.

battery_and_ble.preserve: 108 voltage channels, 15 temperatures, progressive heatmaps, trip SOC, zero-speed/P/charging view and per-field TTL; sequential BLE requests and recovery.

resources_and_state.preserve: Full diagnostics OFF, 1Hz HUD resource/inference readouts, model-priority HUD, finite/reset checks and exact N16 optimization gates. PV5-angle0.30s press confirmation counts repeated overrides only, never delays yielding. Boot repair remains identified-PV5-only with retained marker, original locks and one bounded retry. PV5 simple recovery defaults OFF; confirmation100..500ms/default200 and base ramp1000..3000ms/default1500 are latched per episode. Persistent concordant requested/limited angle errors may slew extra recovery to at most1.5x base and a1s full-range rate. Driver/pre-yield, force, reversal/disagreement, geometry/fault/time/mode changes clear extra evidence. OFF return stays1.5s; original angle/rate/physics/authority limits and other-car/default-OFF CAN outputs remain. No extra model, profiler or Params polling; full authority skips error work. Synthetic EPS/vehicle simulation is not road-safety validation. Filter both concordant angle-error trends; bound look-ahead and retain magnitude qualification, base rate, resets and all maxima.

power_and_boot.preserve: Jetson USB input-power block, black boot diagnostics, regular W/temperature text and permission-gated Park update/previous-release recovery.

release_checks: For exposure changes: run native scene/warp/stride/context/method/fallback tests, compile the actual camerad translation unit, and compare baseline/OFF/ON sampler cost offline. Never report PC microbenchmarks as physical C3X/Orin inference or perception validation.
Verify the complete official ONNX hash/size, actual metadata/dtypes/slices and full graph; compare patched CPU outputs on changed inputs, recurrence and reset.
Validate the exact published archive alone: both model spec filenames and source commit, server imports, native HUD font initialization and first real render; re-download/hash all public assets.
Run the full control-loop tests: test_pv5_lane_center.py, test_lateral_startup_control.py and test_lateral_readiness.py in the native PC test environment.
Run PV5 steering recovery/controller and angle-limit tests, including OFF full-CAN replay equivalence, live switching, driver priority, stale/fault inputs and non-PV5 exclusion.

Run test_pv5_recovery_simulation.py offline with all48 synthetic speed/direction/EPS/delay/curve cases. Compare fixed versus adaptive authority and lateral metrics; disclose unchanged/worse outcomes and remaining large errors. Confirm both real CAN paths, held-driver priority, angle output parity and adaptive qualification/slew/reset/rate ceilings. Do not equate the uncalibrated plant or absence of relative regression with lane-keeping success.

Check PV5 recovery timing native/web defaults200ms/1500ms, all permitted steps, corrupt/default values, first-low-effort episode latching, mid-confirmation/ramp edits, re-entry, fixed1.5s OFF return and enabled-PV5-only50-frame settings reads. Trial ranges and PC packets do not prove vehicle safety; no adaptive lane-departure recovery is enabled.

Run test_stop_object.py and test_stopping.py in the prepared PC CAN/Params boundary environment; include complete publish-to-SCC execution, actual packet field/CRC/accel checks, non-PV5/no-request parity, release, finite raw/wheel-speed boundaries, missing templates and wire tags. Never run heavy validation on the vehicle.

Run PV5 override-filter/controller, CCNC packet and paired pre-port radar/steering output comparisons. Check actual 2.5Hz CAN guide timing, side/end/stale inputs, unchanged other-car frames and model/camera/Jetson source hashes. Do not equate synthetic replay with road safety or hardware inference latency.

Before declaring hardware validation: verify physical Orin TensorRT build/output precision, saved FOV routing, sustained inference/HUD timing, USB/BLE reconnection and EPS/CAN behavior under a controlled procedure.
